text:
Liam (People Ops): Sophie flagged an ADA accommodation request for ergonomic kit before Day-1. She's remote but wants an adjustable monitor arm + split ergonomic keyboard. Also asked about I-9 logistics.
Sophie Tran (new hire): Hi team! I have recurring wrist strain and my doc recommended an ergonomic keyboard and monitor arm. Can Redwood provide these before my first week? Also I can do I-9 via mobile notary if that's supported.
Liam (People Ops): We support accommodations. HR-Accomms will need a completed accommodation request form (no medical details required, just functional needs) + a short note from your clinician if you want expedited procurement. You can DM the docs.
HR-Accomms: Confirmed. Please upload the accommodation form here or to the HR portal. We'll keep everything private. Once approved Procurement will purchase approved equipment. ETA ~3 business days after approval.
Ivy (Benefits): Quick note on reimbursement: if you have FSA/HSA coverage and get equipment yourself, you may be eligible for partial reimbursement depending on prescription. We can loop Payroll for pre-tax options after you enroll.
Sophie Tran (new hire): Uploaded accommodation form and a clinician note to the HR portal. Thanks. Any update on timeline? Day-1 is Monday.
HR-Accomms: Received. We'll fast-track. Procurement lead assigned. Marco (IT) - do we have an ergonomic kit that ships preconfigured for remote hires?
Marco (IT): We keep standard ergonomic kits in inventory: Logitech Ergo Keyboard, Kinesis split model, adjustable monitor arm (Ergotron LX), and a laptop riser. For remote ship we can image and include USB dongles. We can ship overnight if procurement approves today.
Marco (IT): Shipping command we use: ```ship_label --to "Sophie Tran" --addr "Apt 5B, 210 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94103" --service FedEx-2Day --signature required --items "laptop, ergo-kit"```
FacilitiesBot: If Sophie later needs an office workstation setup, we can reserve an Ergotron arm at 200 Townsend desks. Let us know.
Liam (People Ops): I will mark this accommodation request as "expedite" in the tracker. Procurement, please confirm cost center and approval.
Procurement (via DM): Approved under CC: ENG-OPS-2025. Marco, clear to ship from inventory.
Marco (IT): Label created; ETA 2 business days. Imaging note: laptop will be shipped with standard onboarding profile; admin accounts withheld until I-9/background clear.
Sophie Tran (new hire): Thanks! On the I-9: I have a current state ID and passport. I prefer a mobile notary visit. Is that allowed?
HR-Accomms: Mobile notaries are acceptable for employers in states where virtual inspection is not available only if we use an authorized remote notary service + employer attestation. Alternative: authorized representative in the US to complete Section 2. Which do you prefer?
Sophie Tran (new hire): Mobile notary would be easiest. I'm in CA.
Liam (People Ops): CA allows virtual I-9 with authorized providers? We need to check the vendor list. Oliver (Backgrounds) - any implications for background checks if not physically present?
Oliver (Backgrounds) (via DM): Background intake fine with mobile notary docs, but manual verification needed for name normalization. Expect 4-6 hour turnaround after docs are uploaded.
Marco (IT): Shipping snippet for just the ergonomic kit if needed: ```create_label --to "Sophie Tran" --addr "210 Valencia St Apt 5B, SF, CA 94103" --carrier UPS --service Ground --items "Ergo keyboard, monitor arm"```
BadgeBot: If you ever visit SF office, Sophie, I can issue a 48h visitor pass for pickup. Want me to create one?
Sophie Tran (new hire): Yes please for pickup backup. Thank you!
BadgeBot: Visitor pass created for sophie.tran@redwood.com  valid 48 hours from package arrival. QR emailed.
Liam (People Ops): Summary & action items: 1) HR-Accomms approved accommodation and logged it (expedite). 2) Procurement approved purchase CC ENG-OPS-2025. 3) Marco to ship ergo kit + laptop (imaging & limited access). 4) Sophie to schedule mobile notary and upload notarized Section 2 docs. 5) Background team to run manual review after upload. 6) BadgeBot will issue pickup pass if needed.
Sophie Tran (new hire): Mobile notary scheduled for tomorrow 10am. I'll upload notarized Section 2 right after. Appreciate the quick turnaround!
Marco (IT): Shipments queued. Laptop + ergo kit label created. ETA Tuesday morning. We'll withhold VPN and admin until People Ops flips the "i9_cleared" flag.
HR-Accomms: Once notarized docs arrive we'll confirm I-9 status and mark clearance if all matches. We'll DM when cleared.
Liam (People Ops): Great — closing thread after clearance. Welcome aboard Sophie! :tada:
